full_judgment: 6. So far the patta in question ext. 1 is concerned it was admittedly executed on 19. 12. 40. The contesting defendant No. 1 was admittedly born in 1931 and the defendant No. 2 was admittedly born in 1933. Evidently when the said patta was executed the contesting defendants were minors. The defendants No.1 attained majority in 1949 whereas the defendant No. 6 attained majority in 3951. The present suit was instituted in 1950. From the execution of the patta till the institution of the suit, the plaintiffs evident were not in adverse possession of the suit land as against the contesting defendants. As against this admitted position in fact the only question of law for consideration in this case is as to whether the plaintiffs were in adverse possession of the suit land as against the contesting defendants. As against this admitted position in fact the only question of law for consideration in this case is as to whether the plaintiffs were in adverse possession of the suit land as against the contesting defendants since the execution of the patta when they were admittedly minors.
